Quick Start Guide

Prerequisites

Before running Movie Tracker (prod version), ensure the following software is installed:

Software

Version

Docker

Latest stable version

Docker Compose

Latest stable version

TMDB API Key

Required

Installation Steps

Using a bash terminal :

1. Clone the project

git clone https://github.com/DanielSchmerber/SQS26_MovieTracker.git

2. Open project’s folder :

cd SQS26_MovieTracker

3. Start the application

./movietracker.sh up

[!NOTE] During the first startup, the script prompts for a TMDB API key and stores it in the local .env file. If no JWT_SECRET is present, one is generated automatically.

4. Access the application

Under a browser of your choice:

https://localhost

[!NOTE] Traefik uses a self-signed certificate for the local environment. As a result, the browser may display a certificate warning on the first visit.

5. Stop the application

The stack can be stopped and removed using:

./movietracker.sh down

[!NOTE] Local Docker images and database files are not deleted.

Docker Operating Modes

The management script supports both production and development modes. If no mode is specified, prod is used by default.

Command

Description

./movietracker.sh up

Starts production mode using the latest GHCR images

./movietracker.sh up dev

Builds frontend and backend from local source code and starts them

./movietracker.sh down

Stops and removes the stack

Configuration

The runtime configuration is loaded from a .env file located in the project root directory. The .env.example file serves as a template.

Variable

Required

Description

TMDB_APIKEY

Yes

API key or Read Access Token used to access the TMDB API

JWT_SECRET

Yes

Secret key used to sign JWT tokens; automatically generated by the setup script

DATABASE_URL

No

SQLAlchemy database URL. Defaults to sqlite:///./test.db

JWT_ALGORITHM

No

JWT signing algorithm. Defaults to HS256

JWT_EXPIRY_MINUTES

No

Token validity period in minutes. Defaults to 60 minutes

[!TIP] If you would like to explore the dev mode, then read more about local developement

[!TIP] Detailed architecture and quality documentation can be found in the /docs/arc42/ directory.
